# GenMatrix NFT Generator

GenMatrix is a free browser-based NFT collection generator for artists, studios, designer toy creators, 3D collectible teams, and Web3 communities.

Primary topics:
- Free NFT generator
- NFT art generator
- Designer toy and art toy collection workflow
- 3D NFT and digital collectible generation
- Marketplace-ready NFT metadata
- Rarity rules, layer art, trait compatibility, DNA export
- Art, designer toys, 3D NFT, blockchain, free Web3 tools

The app runs locally in the browser. Users can upload artwork layers, set rarity, preview a collection, and export images with JSON metadata. Imported artwork stays on the user's device unless the user exports or uploads files elsewhere.

Canonical URL:
https://genmatrix.xyz/
